visual_baseline.role: 风格比较基准。此版本尚未连接自动参考图条件节点。

characteristics.palette: 低饱和冷灰、灰蓝色，少量红色实景灯光
characteristics.lighting: 有明确光源的冷色照明，保留阴影与环境层次
characteristics.materials: 真实材质、清晰表面细节，轻微胶片颗粒
characteristics.detail_level: 保持结构可读与真实尺度，避免过度锐化和纹理伪影

prompt_blocks.fixed_positive_style: cinematic photograph, realistic materials, cold lighting, restrained atmosphere of mystery and unease, crisp details, subtle film grain
prompt_blocks.fixed_negative_style: anime, cartoon, illustration, oversaturated, blurry, low quality, distorted perspective, watermark
prompt_blocks.content_negative_from_baseline_only: people, person, monster, gore, blood, logo, text
prompt_blocks.content_negative_rule: 基准图的内容排除词只用于空设施场景。每次按新主体与要求重新选择，不能把 people、monster、text 等固化为系列风格。
prompt_blocks.baseline_positive_prompt: A cinematic wide photograph of an underground containment laboratory, a single large sealed observation chamber at the end of a concrete corridor, reinforced steel doors, thick glass observation windows, exposed pipes and cables, cold overhead fluorescent lighting with a subtle red emergency light, realistic industrial materials, restrained atmosphere of mystery and unease, empty facility, symmetrical composition, eye level camera, 24mm lens, physically plausible architecture, crisp details, subtle film grain
prompt_blocks.baseline_negative_prompt: anime, cartoon, illustration, people, person, monster, gore, blood, watermark, logo, text, oversaturated, blurry, low quality, distorted perspective

defaults.seed_policy: 每次登记种子。新画面可用不同种子；重现基准图时使用记录中的种子。
defaults.camera: 由每张图的构图需求决定

requires_new_revision: 更换主模型、VAE 或风格 LoRA
加入或改变自动风格参考图条件
改变固定风格提示词或主要色彩、材质、光线规则
改变影响画面质感的采样、放大或后期设置

archived_workflows.role: 基准图生成流程快照。下一张需按 prompt_blocks 替换内容、记录新种子并生成独立副本。

quality_check.drift_action: 先在当前风格版本内调整新内容的措辞与构图；若需要改变锁定设置或增加风格控制模块，建立新版本并保留旧版本。
quality_check.validation_scope: 基准图及完整生成链路已经验证。风格提示词拆分是新定义，尚未对一组新主题进行风格一致性实测。
